author: Roy 'Horizon' Amkreutz
title: Starblade I: Dark Crescent Moon
forces: Historical: Eldar Spirit of Arina (Admiral Akaeris Starblade, Ld9, 1 re-roll) and Wraithship Eternity; Ork Terror Kroozer Da Basha, 6 Onslaught Attack Ships, 3 Ravager Attack Ships, Savage Gunships.
summary: Two Eldar ships race through an Ork-held asteroid field (D3 asteroid fields per 60cm square on a 180 x 120cm table). The Ork fleet is split into four equal parts on markers plus two blanks, activated as in the rulebook Convoy scenario. The Eldar win by exiting the opposite short edge; the Orks win if the Spirit of Arina is destroyed.
special_rules: Eldar enter from the sunward short edge

xr_conflicts.topic: Eldar rules and the Spirit of Arina
xr_conflicts.source_text: the Flame of Asuryan model is used. In essence the vessel is a carbon copy of the Legendary Iyanden vessel. ... Note: These scenarios can also be played using the Eldar MMS rules (at www.tacticalwargames.net) were the Void Dragon profile is used to represent the Spirit of Arina.
xr_conflicts.xr_text: the booklet uses the fan Eldar MMS v2.0 rules, which take priority over XR's Eldar
xr_conflicts.effect: Written for the older Eldar rules (Flame of Asuryan from Yriel's Raiders, Vampire Raiders added to its bays). The booklet's Eldar are MMS v2.0, and the source itself offers the Void Dragon as the substitute. The Wraithship, Dragonship, Shadowhunter, Aconite, Hemlock and Nightshade classes exist in the booklet's Eldar list.

xr_conflicts.topic: Contact markers from the old Convoy scenario
xr_conflicts.source_text: The rules for markers and activation are the same as those in the Convoy scenario from the rulebook.
xr_conflicts.xr_text: contact markers
xr_conflicts.effect: A pointer to the original rulebook Convoy; the booklet's narrative Convoy has contact markers, so the pointer is swapped for that scenario's name with its marker rules.

xr_conflicts: Checked: first turn (Eldar); victory by exit; asteroid fields (s.39 leadership tests apply).
missing_or_unclear: 'Four equal parts' by points or units.
Number of blank markers beyond 'two extra'.
Whether Ork ships' Ld is rolled or fixed (fixed in the list).
notes: Part of a nine-scenario narrative. Historical vessels are fixed named ships with set Leadership; damage and critical hits carry over between scenarios 1-2.
